newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ssangyong wins 320 mln rgt Malaysian hotel deal.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong wins 320 mln rgt Malaysian hotel deal.

text.p: Malaysia's Mycom Bhd on Thursday awarded a contract worth 320 million ringgit ($129.3 million) to South Korea's Ssangyong Engineering & Construction Co Ltd, a unit of Ssangyong Group, to build a hotel and office tower in Kuala Lumpur.
Construction of the 570 million ringgit Duta Grand Hyatt is scheduled for completion in 1998.

Duta Grand Hyatt, an integrated 53-storey commercial building with a 550-room hotel, service apartments and offices, is the single largest property project undertaken by Mycom, a gaming, property and hotels concern.
The hotel will be managed by Hyatt International.
